POLICE HEADQUARTERS, BETWEEN 1st and 2nd NOVEMBER 1943.

(1) Charles J. Hasham, Burmese, 126/21 Szechuen Road(Male).
(2) Ooth RATANAKANAKA, Thai, 223 Av. Dubail, 22.
(3) Rouchi " " - do - "

(5) M.H. Harper Lamberton," 1236/8 Av. Joffre (Female) Tel. 74637.
(6) Ampen Limvichit " 1129/88 B'well Rd. (Female) Tel.39349.
(7) Thai Siang Maprasert " 125 The Bund (Male)
(8) Koh Keng Boon " 391 Bubbling Well Rd. Tel. 33458.
(9) Sa Ngian Sursombati " 627 Rue Bourgeat (Female)
(10) Dorothy Miller " 1236/8 Av. Joffre (Female) Tel. 74637.

Married to Chinese Siao Chu Yar, 27, native of
Shanghai, unemployed at present, residing at
No. 125 The Bund.
Passport No. 7024/2481, issued on 23-9-1940.

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT
347
1-11-43
Foreign Affairs, C&Sp.3 Station File No....................Date October 30th, 1943...

SUBJECT: Re THE BROADCAST AT 8 am. OCTOBER 30th. 1943
REGARDING THE THAI AND BURMESE NATIONALS
OVER THE STATION XNHA.

Sir,

I beg to report that at the morning news broadcast
over the Station XNHA at about 8.05 am to-day the fol-
lowing anouncement was broadcasted re the Thai and Bur-
mese nationals, the wording was as follows:

"All Thai and Burmese nationals residing in
185 Foochow Rd.
Shanghai have to present themselves at Police H.Q. Room
207 on November 1st and 2nd 1943. The reason for this
anouncement was not known". Central Press.

An article to the same effect was published by the
Shanghai Times to-day.

Thai, Burmese Here.
Asked To Report
To Police Hqrs.

All Thai and Burmese
nationals residing within
the limits of the Shanghai
Special Municipality are
requested to attend Police
Headquarters, 185 Foo-
chow Road, Room 207,
between the hours of 9
a.m. and 12 noon on
November 1 and 2.

（批：Reg
Thai
&
Burmes
